description: Real, verified fields only. Population/area/density come from Eurostat/GISCO's LAU 2021 GeoPackage (https://gisco-services.ec.europa.eu/distribution/v2/lau/gpkg/LAU_RG_01M_2021_4326.gpkg), which republishes each Spanish municipality's official INE-sourced boundary together with a POP_2021 figure. Verified 2026-08-19 against real downloaded data: Gipuzkoa (LAU_ID prefix '20') = 88 municipalities, population 726,033; Araba ('01') = 51 municipalities, population 333,626; Bizkaia ('48') = 112 municipalities, population 1,154,334 -- all match documented real totals. Eustat's own Data Bank API (https://www.eustat.eus/bankupx/api/v1/es/DB) IS reachable and keyless (re-verified live 2026-08-20; an earlier check of this module mistyped the path as 'bancopx' and wrongly concluded it was blocked -- see euskadi/api.py). It has richer, more current fields (households, age structure, Basque-language use, income) than GISCO's 2021 snapshot used here; switching this loader to source directly from it is a real follow-up, not done in this pass. opendata.euskadi.eus and eustat.eus/geoservicios/descargas.html (boundary-file candidates) remain genuinely unreachable to a scripted client (404/403).

features.definition: Number of people residing in the municipality (Eurostat/GISCO LAU 2021 vintage).
Municipality land area in square kilometers (Eurostat/GISCO LAU 2021).

Population per square kilometer, computed as population / areaKm2 (Eurostat/GISCO LAU 2021 does not publish a density column directly; there is no raw 'POP_DENS_2021' code -- this is computed in loader.py from the two real codes listed here).
